# popnow-js

> `popnow` is the official TypeScript / JavaScript SDK for the PopNow API (https://popnow.ai), a single API for AI video, image, music and speech generation (Kling, Seedance, Wan, Vidu, MiniMax, Nano Banana, GPT Image, Flux, Suno and more). Zero runtime dependencies; runs on Node.js 18+, Deno, Bun, Cloudflare Workers and edge runtimes. MIT licensed.

## Install and authenticate

- `npm install popnow`; import from `popnow`
- API key from https://popnow.ai/api/console/keys, sent as `Authorization: Bearer sk-popnow-...`; the client reads `POPNOW_API_KEY` by default.
- Add funds to the API balance at https://popnow.ai/api/console/billing (it starts at $0).
- API base `https://api.popnow.ai`, native endpoints under `/api/v1`. Responses use the envelope `{code,msg,data,request_id}`; the SDK unwraps `data` and throws typed errors otherwise.

## Main calls

- `new PopNow({ apiKey, baseURL, timeout, maxRetries, language })`
- `popnow.jobs.quote(params)` -> exact USD price without holding anything (`maxChargeUsd`, `expectedChargeUsd`, `quoteId`)
- `popnow.jobs.create({ model, input, callBackUrl?, quoteId?, expectedCostUsd? }, { idempotencyKey?, wait?, retention? })` -> `{ taskId, state, estimatedCostUsd }`; confirm a quote with `quoteId` and `expectedCostUsd: quote.maxChargeUsd`
- `popnow.jobs.get(taskId)`, `popnow.jobs.wait(taskId, { signal, timeout, pollInterval, throwOnFailure })`, `popnow.jobs.createAndWait(params)`
- `popnow.jobs.list(filters)`, `popnow.jobs.listAll(filters)`, `popnow.jobs.retry(taskId)`, `popnow.jobs.purge(taskId)`
- `popnow.models.list({ modality, provider, task, search, includeSchema })`, `popnow.models.get(modelId)`
- `popnow.files.upload(blobOrBytes, { contentType? })` -> `{ uri: 'popnow://f/fil_...' }`; `popnow.files.import({ url, token })` for LoRA weights; `popnow.files.downloadUrl({ taskId })`
- `popnow.assets.create|list|listAll|get|update|delete|usage`, `popnow.assets.characters.list|get` -> stable `popnow://a/ast_...` URIs
- `popnow.account.balance()` -> `{ availableUsd, heldUsd, totalUsd }`, `popnow.account.usage({ from, to })` -> `{ totalSpend, days, models }`
- `verifyWebhook({ payload, headers, secret })` for task callbacks; `verifyStandardWebhook` for account endpoints

## Facts

- Model IDs look like `<maker>/<model>/<task>`, e.g. `alibaba/z-image-turbo/text-to-image`, `alibaba/wan-3.0/image-to-video`, `kling/3.0/text-to-video`.
- Task states: queued, running, succeeded, failed, expired (canceled only on old records).
- Billing: USD from a separate prepaid API balance. Website credits are separate and cannot pay for API calls. A model costs the same on the API as on popnow.ai for the same settings.
- Amounts are exact USD decimal strings with up to 9 decimals (`maxChargeUsd`, `estimatedCostUsd`, `costUsd`, `availableUsd`); keep them as strings. A task's `costUsd` is the hold until `settled` is true, then the final charge.
- Integer credit fields (`maxCredits`, `estimatedCredits`, `credits`, `availableCredits`, ...) are deprecated projections at 1 credit = $0.001.
- Failed or expired tasks release their hold; you pay nothing for them.
- Output links (`output.assets[].url`) are signed and last about 20 minutes.
